import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

types = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
  {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
  {"name": "Pair", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["a", "U8"], ["b", "B"]]},
  {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Pair", "size": 2},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
]
# m: p: Arr -> x0 array, Pair x1 (struct) a x2 b x3, Pair x4, a x5 b x6; s: Str x7 buf, x8 x9; r U8 x10
def mk(pairs, s, r):
    objs = []
    for j, (a, b) in enumerate(pairs):
        objs.append(obj("x%d" % (2 + j * 3), a, 1))
        objs.append(obj("x%d" % (3 + j * 3), b, 1))
    objs += [obj("x8", ord(s[0]) if s else 0, 1), obj("x9", ord(s[1]) if len(s) > 1 else 0, 1)]
    objs.append(obj("x10", r, 1))
    return {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objs)}

def doc_for(requires):
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["p", "Arr"], ["s", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"],
                "requires": requires}]
    return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"],
            "machine": None, "runs": []}

def status(requires, pairs, s):
    doc = doc_for(requires)
    doc["runs"] = [mk(pairs, s, 0)]
    return run(doc)["records"][0]["status"]

EQ_AGG = ["eq", ["var", "p"],
          ["const", "Arr", [{"a": 1, "b": True}, {"a": 2, "b": False}]]]
assert status(EQ_AGG, [(1, 1), (2, 0)], "x") == "READY"
assert status(EQ_AGG, [(1, 1), (2, 1)], "x") == "FILTERED"
print("PASS aggregate constant equality")

NE_AGG = ["ne", ["var", "p"],
          ["const", "Arr", [{"a": 1, "b": True}, {"a": 2, "b": False}]]]
assert status(NE_AGG, [(1, 1), (2, 0)], "x") == "FILTERED"
assert status(NE_AGG, [(1, 1), (2, 1)], "x") == "READY"
print("PASS aggregate inequality")

# all over an array of structs compared with a struct constant
ALL_AGG = ["all", "e", ["var", "p"], ["eq", ["var", "e"], ["const", "Pair", {"a": 1, "b": True}]]]
assert status(ALL_AGG, [(1, 1), (1, 1)], "x") == "READY"
assert status(ALL_AGG, [(1, 1), (2, 1)], "x") == "FILTERED"
print("PASS all over aggregate elements")

# string equality keeps embedded NULs (no truncation of constants)
EQ_STR = ["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "Str", "a\x00b"]]
assert status(EQ_STR, [(1, 1), (1, 1)], "a\x00b") == "READY"   # impossible: recovered value truncates
print("note: a recovered string never contains NUL, so a NUL constant never matches")
assert status(EQ_STR, [(1, 1), (1, 1)], "a") == "FILTERED"
print("PASS string constants are not truncated")
PYEOF
